en.title: Check Whether Each Number Is a Power of Two
en.description:
Determine whether each number in the array equals 2 raised to some non-negative integer power, returning 1 or 0.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and solution; bounds missing from the source and corrections to the examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n integers. Full original bounds: 1≤n≤100, 0≤a[i]≤50000000.
en.output: Output n values 0 or 1 in input order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 1 1 0 1 0; 0; 1 0. They were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: A positive integer has exactly one binary 1 if and only if v&(v−1)=0; rule out 0 first.
